lines: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的；
你使我受苦是以诚实待我。
耶和華啊，我知道你的判語是公義的；
你使我受苦是以誠實待我。
I know
O LORD
that thy judgments are right
and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

LORD
I know that your judgments are righteous
that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
I have seen
O Lord
that your decisions are right
and that in unchanging faith you have sent trouble on me.
求你照着应许仆人的话，
以慈爱安慰我。
求你照着應許僕人的話，
以慈愛安慰我。
Let
I pray thee
thy merciful kindness be for my comfort
according to thy word unto thy servant .

I pray thee
thy merciful kindness be for my comfort
according to thy word unto thy servant .
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort
according to your word to your servant.
Let your mercy now be my comfort
as you have said to your servant.
愿你的慈悲临到我，
使我存活，因你的律法是我所喜爱的。
願你的慈悲臨到我，

that I may live; for your law is my delight.
Let your gentle mercies come to me
so that I may have life; for your law is my delight.

Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees
that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
Let all my heart be given to your orders
so that I may not be put to shame.
我心渴想你的救恩，
仰望你的应许。
我心渴想你的救恩，
仰望你的應許。

仰望你的應許。

My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
My soul is wasted with desire for your salvation: but I have hope in your word.
我因盼望你的应许眼睛失明，
说：你何时安慰我？
我因盼望你的應許眼睛失明，
說：你何時安慰我？
Mine eyes fail for thy word
saying
When wilt thou comfort me?

saying
When wilt thou comfort me?
My eyes fail for your word. I say
“When will you comfort me?”
My eyes are full of weariness with searching for your word
saying
When will you give me comfort?
你的命令尽都诚实；
他们无理的逼迫我，
求你帮助我！
你的命令盡都誠實；
他們無理的逼迫我，
求你幫助我！
All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully ; help thou me.

他們無理的逼迫我，
求你幫助我！
All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully ; help thou me.
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
All your teachings are certain; they go after me with evil design; give me your help.
耶和华啊，你的话安定在天，
直到永远。
耶和華啊，你的話安定在天，
直到永遠。
For ever
O LORD
thy word is settled in heaven .

直到永遠。

O LORD
thy word is settled in heaven .
LORD
your word is settled in heaven forever.
For ever
O Lord
your word is fixed in heaven.
你的诚实存到万代；
你坚定了地，地就长存。
你的誠實存到萬代；
你堅定了地，地就長存。
Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth
and it abideth .

你的誠實存到萬代；
你堅定了地，地就長存。
Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth
and it abideth .
Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth
and it remains.
Your faith is unchanging from generation to generation: you have put the earth in its place
and it is not moved.
我若不是喜爱你的律法，
早就在苦难中灭绝了！
我若不是喜愛你的律法，

If your law had not been my delight
my troubles would have put an end to me.
我永不忘记你的训词，
因你用这训词将我救活了。
我永不忘記你的訓詞，

I will never forget your precepts
for with them
you have revived me.
I will ever keep your orders in mind; for in them I have life.
我何等爱慕你的律法，
我终日不住地思想。
我何等愛慕你的律法，

O what love I have for your law! I give thought to it all the day.

你的命令常存在我心裏，
